decisions.sourceLocator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 section 3.1, printed p.14 / PDF p.29; ISA ICD 6.0r5 section 6.5, printed pp.21–22 / PDF pp.29–30
decisions.nativeMeaning: Upper bound on the elapsed time between consecutive component Status transmissions. The ICD associates this bound with Status heartbeat reporting.
decisions.candidateLabel: Maximum interval between component Status reports
decisions.boundary: This reporting bound is not a measurement sampling period, an observed result's availability time, a network-delivery guarantee, or proof that a real component is alive. A property definition supplies no installed numeric value.

decisions.sourceLocator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 section 3.1, printed p.14 / PDF p.29; ISA ICD 6.0r5 section 6.5, printed pp.21–22 / PDF pp.29–30
decisions.nativeMeaning: Lower bound on the elapsed time between component Status transmissions. State changes during this interval are cached and sent when transmission is next allowed; the ICD explains that this prevents excessive Status-message frequency.
decisions.candidateLabel: Minimum interval between component Status reports
decisions.boundary: Do not equate this with a sensor sampling period, a periodic observation schedule, or a promised log of every intervening transition. No configured or default numeric interval is inferred.

decisions.sourceLocator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 section 3.1, printed p.14 / PDF p.29; String section 4.1, printed p.50 / PDF p.65
decisions.nativeMeaning: Human-friendly component name that can be reassigned or changed.
decisions.boundary: A changeable display name is not the persistent UCI, manufacturer name, product-model designation or serial number. Uniqueness, issuer authority and a particular assigning actor are not asserted by this definition.

decisions.sourceLocator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 section 3.1, printed p.14 / PDF p.29; General State pp.93–94 / PDF pp.108–109; General Code p.79 / PDF p.94
decisions.nativeMeaning: Current state of the component itself, expressly distinguished from the component's ISA lifecycle state. General State carries one required code and optional component-specific subcode and human-readable details.
decisions.boundary: Operating condition is not automatically a selected operating mode, capability readiness, power state, ISA connection lifecycle, or verified physical truth. Keep the existing Camera Mode correspondence; do not replace it with this broader property. No live unit state is inferred.
